tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification Policy

TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds of this project, development builds included; there is no development-build exception. The project's recorded position on transport is also HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a one-paragraph policy. It says TLS certificate verification is on for all builds, development builds included, with no development-build exception. It also notes the recorded position of HTTPS everywhere with no plaintext exceptions.

Both statements come from the project's current recorded decisions: #28 (verification on all builds) and #31 (HTTPS everywhere). The earlier records they replaced are retired, so the file doesn't mention them.
